mods.name: Scipi's-Lights
mods.description:
There are many glass mods out there, but most of them share the same problem: they are not
compatible with mods like Copycats. That means if you want colored, glowing glass inside a
copycat block, most of the existing glass mods simply don't work for that.

That's why this mod exists. It adds glowing glass and glass panes in every Minecraft color,
each in a soft and a strong light variant, built in a way that keeps them fully usable with copycats.

releases.notes:
First release of Scipi's-Lights.

- Glowing glass and glass panes in all 16 Minecraft dye colors plus a colorless variant
- Soft (light level 8) and strong (light level 15) variants for each color
- Crafting recipes from vanilla (stained) glass/panes using glowstone or glowstone dust
- Fully compatible with copycat mods
- For NeoForge, Minecraft 1.21.1

readmeSummary: A small NeoForge mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that adds glowing glass.
